summary: Aetherion Technologies Inc. (formerly Westport Fuel Systems), a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, dated November 12, 2026, signed by CFO Elizabeth Owens. No transaction, stake, price, or strategic event is disclosed; exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 are incorporated by reference into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. This is an ordinary quarterly reporting update, not a special situation; watch for subsequent operational disclosures on Cespira's HPDI and hydrogen programs.
